# hookbase_source (Data Source)

Look up an existing Hookbase source by ID or slug.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Source ID.
- `slug` (String) Source slug. Provide either id or slug.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_methods` (List of String)
- `awaiting_signing_secret` (Boolean) True when no secret is set and only the vendor can issue one (e.g. stripe before it is pasted, or asana/notion until the ingest URL is registered); events are accepted unverified until it is set.
- `created_at` (String)
- `dedup_enabled` (Boolean)
- `dedup_strategy` (String)
- `dedup_window_hours` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `has_signing_secret` (Boolean) Whether a signing secret is stored for this source.
- `ip_allowlist` (List of String)
- `ip_denylist` (List of String)
- `ip_filter_mode` (String)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `provider_type` (String)
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number)
- `reject_invalid_signatures` (Boolean)
- `transient_mode` (Boolean)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verifies_without_secret` (Boolean) True when the provider signs with a key it publishes (wise, wise-sandbox, aws-sns), so no signing secret is stored or needed.
